venue_writebacks.change: Increase PUTT_Short_Conv weight from 0.16 to 0.19; increase PUTT_Lag from 0.10 to 0.11
venue_writebacks.evidence_basis: 4-round validated evidence. Putting SG was 39.1% of top-10 SG premium (SG-PUTT avg +3.230 for top-10) vs 26% combined model putting weight. All top-6 finishers had SG-PUTT > +1.0 total. Signal history: R1=neutral, R2=validated, R3=validated, R4=mixed (signal mixed but SG-PUTT absolute value was highest of all categories). Note: trait predictor (putt_short_conv delta = +2.0) is weak -- putting weight is a venue importance weight, not a trait predictability weight.
venue_writebacks.model_variance_note: Putting performance at TPC River Highlands is high-variance week-to-week. Elevated weight reflects importance of the category, not predictability from 12m traits. Add annotation to venue profile: putting_variance_class = high.

venue_writebacks.evidence_basis: 4-round contradicted signal on distance enrichment. Final tournament: top-10 drove it 1.4 yards SHORTER than field average (283.5 vs 284.9 yds). R1 signal was 'weak' (trait delta -5.4, enrichment neutral). Consensus across 4 rounds = 'mixed' with consistent enrichment contradiction. Distance is not a scoring differentiator at TPC River Highlands.

4-round validated signal. Trait deltas: R1=+5.6, R2=+12.9, R3=+12.2, R4=+11.0. Proxy-confirmed on GIR and fairway proximity all 4 rounds. TPC River Highlands has 2 reachable par-5s that consistently create birdie separation. The 3% weight materially under-represents this scoring opportunity.

Approach (combined 40% weight) realized 33.9% of top-10 SG premium in final tournament. 4-round validated trait signal confirms approach is important but combined weight over-indexes vs putting. APP_Wedge is the largest single-trait weight and absorbs the calibration slack.
venue_writebacks.note: Approach remains the highest-weighted individual trait — this is a fine-tuning not a directional reversal.

venue_writebacks.evidence_basis: Fleetwood (18 rounds, CH SG +1.76) finished T14 with SG-APP 38th (his primary model-value trait). His 18-round history spans 5+ seasons of varying form; older rounds over-inflated his expected approach performance. Hovland (19 rounds, CH SG +1.423) won — but his history is more recent (active 2022-2025 at this venue). Henley (30 rounds, CH SG +1.445) also slightly underperformed. 2-3 player evidence with consistent mechanism.

venue_writebacks.evidence_basis: 3-player pattern across this event: (1) Morikawa (APP elite 12m, neutral PUTT) finished 3rd but had SG-ARG -3.296 (67th) and PUTT only 15th; (2) Cantlay (APP 8th in event, PUTT 28th) finished T14 with 8th-best approach — elite approach without putts = mid-pack ceiling; (3) Burns (APP strong, ARG -3.120) capped at T12. Elite approach without putting heat yields top-10 to top-15, not podium.

engine_rule_flags.change: Add modifier: if wedge_liability flag is active AND max(ARG_Rough_score, ARG_Bunker_score) >= 70, reduce wedge_liability VTS penalty by 40%
engine_rule_flags.current_behavior: wedge_liability applies full penalty regardless of ARG trait strength
engine_rule_flags.recommended_behavior: if wedge_liability AND (arg_rough_score >= 70 OR arg_bunker_score >= 70): multiply wedge_liability_penalty by 0.60
engine_rule_flags.evidence_basis: Two direct examples this event: (1) Justin Thomas — wedge_liability fired correctly (SG-APP -2.616, 56th), but SG-ARG +6.257 (1st in field) produced a T14 vs model rank 49. His ARG_Rough and ARG_Bunker scores were above average. (2) Alex Fitzpatrick — wedge_liability assigned him to Tier 5 (rank 57); actual SG-APP was +5.518 (5th in field). His ARG profile was strong. When a player can scramble well, the wedge_liability penalty overstates the scoring risk of missed greens.
engine_rule_flags.validation_note: Review against 3 additional events before applying universally. Thomas example may be extreme ARG variance; Alex Fitz example is more structurally reliable.

engine_rule_flags.change: Add threshold gate to rough_approach_liab anti-pattern: flag only fires if ARG_Rough trait score < 55
engine_rule_flags.current_behavior: rough_approach_liab fires based on approach accuracy and OTT metrics without testing ARG_Rough compensating ability
engine_rule_flags.recommended_behavior: if rough_approach_liab trigger conditions met AND ARG_Rough_score >= 55: suppress flag (player can scramble out of rough effectively)
engine_rule_flags.evidence_basis: Corey Conners (rank 51, rough_approach_liab active) finished T7 with SG-ARG +3.492 (7th in field) — directly contradicting the rough approach liability. MacIntyre (rank 43, rough_approach_liab active) finished T10 with SG-APP +3.598 (10th). Both players had ARG profiles above the 55 threshold. The flag was applied on OTT/approach accuracy metrics without a compensating check on scrambling ability.
engine_rule_flags.validation_note: Gate threshold of 55 is provisional. Validate with 3+ events before finalizing.
